title: Check run creation loses write access
root_cause: The rebased workflow changes the token's checks permission from write to read. The build succeeds, but the subsequent check-run creation request needs checks write permission and receives a 403. The histories diverged, so the successful run is only partially comparable.

relevant_evidence.why: The job token has read access to checks.
Creating a check run fails with a 403 after the build succeeds.
The workflow configures the token permissions.
